title: Figure code for: A Non-Local Model of Growth-Induced Metabolic Decoupling in Tumors
description: Code that reproduces every data figure in D. Levy, A Non-Local Model of Growth-Induced Metabolic Decoupling in Tumors, Journal of the Royal Society Interface (2026). Figures 1 and 2 of the paper are TikZ schematics inside the manuscript source and have no code here. The remaining four data figures are generated by the scripts in code/; run make or follow the per-figure commands in the README. Python 3.11 or later with numpy, scipy and matplotlib. All stages are deterministic, so a clean run reproduces the published figures.
